battle.name: 楊劉之戰
battle.brief: 同光元年（九二三）五月，後梁招討使王彥章與段凝聯軍十萬自德勝南城拆屋作筏沿黃河東下，逼攻鄆州楊劉渡口，與唐軍在河中互射一日百次；唐以鎮使李敬周守城，樞密使郭崇韜在博州築新城牽制，梁軍終於退走。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬希臘方陣，公元前八百年已定形；九百年後的中原，爭的是船、筏與渡口。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是五代中原最後兩股成建制的力量：後梁與晉國（李存勖所部，後來建國號後唐）。後梁以汴州為都，朱友貞在位，倚賴各鎮節度使的州鎮兵與拱衛京師的內外軍、殿前司，樞密院掌軍機；河北與山東一線的州縣多已歸晉，梁廷能直接調動的精兵，集中在北面招討使王彥章與招討副使段凝麾下。晉方以河東為根本，晉陽是節度使牙軍與沙陀騎兵的來源，河北諸鎮降附後，趙州、鎮州、魏州方向供給人馬；樞密使郭崇韜掌軍務與器械，李存勖自將中軍，蕃漢馬步都虞候朱守殷領混合兵種，游奕將李紹興管騎隊巡邏，鎮使李敬周守楊劉，宦官焦彥賓奉命協防。場外同樣在算帳：北面契丹與幽州、雲州諸軍在燕雲一線互相牽制，吳越、南唐、前蜀、楚各自遣使觀望，沒有一方願意先押錯注。因此這場戰爭的分量，全落在河南黃河下游那座渡口堡壘上。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the last two organized military powers of the Central Plain in the Five Dynasties: the Later Liang, and the Jin under Li Cunxu, the state that would later found the Later Tang. The Later Liang had its capital at Bianzhou under Zhu Youzhen and relied on the troops of the circuits ruled by the jiedushi, together with the inner and outer guards and the Palace Guard that defended the capital, with the Privy Council handling military affairs. Most of Hebei and the line of Shandong had already gone over to the Jin, so the picked troops that the Liang court could still move directly were concentrated under the Commander of the Northern Front, Wang Yanzhang, and his deputy Duan Ning. The Jin had their base in Hedong, where Jinyang was the source of the jiedushi tooth soldiers and of the Shatuo horse; after the circuits of Hebei had submitted, men and horses were supplied through Zhaozhou, Zhenzhou and Weizhou. The Privy Councillor Guo Chongtao managed military affairs and equipment, Li Cunxu commanded the central army in person, the Chief Colonel of the Mixed Han and Foreign Horse and Infantry Zhu Shouyin led a mixed arm, the Colonel of the Patrol Li Shaoxing handled the mounted screen, the town commander Li Jingzhou held Yangliu, and the eunuch Jiao Yanbin was sent to share in the defence. Outside the field, others were doing their own sums as well: in the north the Khitan and the armies of Youzhou and Yunzhou pulled against each other along the Yan-Yun frontier, while Wuyue, Southern Tang, Former Shu and Chu all sent envoys to watch, and not one of them wanted to bet on the wrong side. The whole weight of the contest therefore fell on a single fortified crossing on the lower Yellow River in Henan.
people: 決定楊劉歸屬的，是晉王李存勖與後梁招討使王彥章兩人的對手。王彥章以善騎射、能治軍著稱，是梁末最能打的將領之一；五月他先取德勝南城，把房屋拆成木筏載兵沿黃河東下，又在河中與唐軍互射一日百次，到楊劉時雙方傷亡近半，五月二十六日更與段凝合軍十萬晝夜攻擊楊劉，並將巨艦九艘連接橫置在渡口以斷唐軍援兵，攻不下乃退屯城南連營而守。唐莊宗李存勖的應手是拆守：派宦官焦彥賓入楊劉與鎮使李敬周共守，又令蕃漢馬步都虞候朱守殷放棄德勝北城，同樣拆屋作筏，把北城儲糧運往澶州，途中損耗近半。樞密使郭崇韜是此役的樞紐，六月初二日李存勖抵達楊劉，見梁軍備嚴密，與郭崇韜商定以築城調敵：郭崇韜率大軍一萬連夜趕到博州，六天築成新城，迫使王彥章分兵，十五日梁軍攻新城又以十餘艘巨艦連橫河道，李存勖親率大軍在西岸列陣相援，梁軍乃砍斷繩索收船退保鄒家口。七月十六日李存勖遣李紹榮至梁營擒哨兵、燒掉相連的戰艦，十七日王彥章得知晉王已到鄒家口，撤軍逃向楊村。收束全局的則是段凝：他看出晉軍已從黃河上游南渡，責備王彥章不該深入鄆州地境，一句話把梁軍的戰略分歧與士氣崩落都點了出來。
peopleEn: The question of who would hold Yangliu was settled by the duel between the Prince of Jin Li Cunxu and Wang Yanzhang, the Commander of the Northern Front of the Later Liang. Wang Yanzhang, famous for his riding and shooting and for his command of soldiers, was one of the best generals the Liang had at the end of its days. In May he first took the south city of Desheng, had the houses pulled down and turned into rafts to carry men down the Yellow River, and exchanged arrows with the Tang in mid-river a hundred times a day, both sides losing nearly half their strength by the time they reached Yangliu. On the twenty-sixth of May he joined with Duan Ning to bring a hundred thousand men against Yangliu day and night, and chained nine great ships across the crossing to cut off Tang relief, and when the city did not fall he withdrew to the south of the city and camped in a connected line. Li Cunxu's answer was a defence arranged by subtraction: he sent the eunuch Jiao Yanbin into Yangliu to hold the town together with its commander Li Jingzhou, and ordered the Chief Colonel of the Mixed Han and Foreign Horse and Infantry, Zhu Shouyin, to abandon the north city of Desheng, to pull its houses down into rafts in the same way, and to move the grain stored there to Chan Prefecture, nearly half of it lost on the way. The pivot of the whole affair was the Privy Councillor Guo Chongtao. On the second of June Li Cunxu reached Yangliu, saw how well the Liang position was guarded, and agreed with Guo Chongtao to draw the enemy off by building a new town. Guo took ten thousand men and rode all night to Bozhou, raised a new city in six days, and forced Wang Yanzhang to divide his force; on the fifteenth the Liang attacked the new town and chained another ten or more great ships across the channel to cut off relief, and Li Cunxu came up in person and drew his army up in line on the west bank of the new town, so that the Liang men cut their ropes, took up their ships and fell back to Zoujiakou. On the sixteenth of July Li Cunxu sent Li Shaorong into the Liang camp to seize its pickets and burn the ships that had been chained together, and on the seventeenth Wang Yanzhang learned that the Prince of Jin had already reached Zoujiakou and withdrew towards Yangcun. What closed the affair was Duan Ning: seeing that the Tang army had already crossed the Yellow River further upstream and was coming down for Bianzhou, he blamed Wang Yanzhang for driving so deep into the territory of Yun Prefecture, and that one sentence laid bare both the divergence of strategy in the Liang command and the collapse of its morale.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是斯巴達長矛：一根約兩米長的木槍，槍尾包著銅套，槍首裝扁平葉形的金屬矛頭；槍尾的銅套既加厚槍身，也是插地立槍、支撐盾牌的支點。它不是裝飾，而是公元前八世紀斯巴達重步兵方陣裡真正決定站位與秩序的長兵器，與圓盾、短劍配合，士卒列陣相接時，前排槍尖越過肩頭越過盾沿，後排再把槍壓上去，一層層把方陣的正面頂成一片。那是希臘人用結構換勝利的法子。看楊劉一戰的實物配備，正好是這套邏輯的反面與延伸：晉軍骨幹是沙陀騎兵，騎士著皮甲或札甲，戴兜鍪，佩環首直刀與長柄刀，馬上用角木桑皮為骨的弓，配標槊；步卒列長槊橫陣，舉大盾遮身，用步槍與陌刀近身，弩手與床弩在城頭、壘後放箭。梁軍在這場戰爭裡用的木筏，是把城鎮的房梁屋柱拆下來釘成的浮具，載人載物順流而下；巨艦連接橫置在河心，是把船當作浮壘與封鎖線。攻城一端，柵壘、鹿角、壕溝是楊劉城外的第一道牆，晉軍靠毀鹿角、填壕逼近城根；守城一方有雲梯、撞車、飛石砲與拒馬，後唐還曾以弩箭與木柵硬扛十萬大軍的連日攻擊。兩件武器的共同點都在於讓隊形站得住：斯巴達人靠槍尾的銅套與相接的圓盾，五代軍隊靠木筏、連艦與壘壁；九百年後的楊劉，決定勝負的已不是矛尖的長短，而是浮具與渡口的控制。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Spartan dory: a wooden spear about two metres long, its butt fitted with a bronze socket and its head carrying a flat leaf-shaped blade. The bronze socket both thickened the shaft and gave the spear a point that could be planted in the ground to steady a shield. It was no ornament; it was the long weapon that in the phalanx of the Spartan heavy infantry of the eighth century BCE actually determined the placing of men and the order of the line. Used together with the round shield and the short sword, the front rank thrust its spearheads over the shoulders and over the rim of the shields, and the rank behind pressed its spears forward over those, layer by layer, until the front of the phalanx was a single sheet. That was the Greek way of buying victory with structure. The equipment actually used at Yangliu is the reverse of that logic and its extension: the backbone of the Jin army was Shatuo cavalry, riders in leather or lamellar armour with helmets, carrying ring-pommel straight swords and long-handled sabres, shooting with bows of horn and sinew on a mulberry core, and carrying lighter javelins for the charge; the infantry fought in long-spear lines, covered their bodies with large shields, used spear and long cutting sword at close quarters, and crossbowmen with heavy crossbows shot from the wall and from behind the works. The rafts the Liang used in this war were built by pulling down the beams and posts of the houses of the towns and nailing them together into floats that carried men and stores down the stream; the great ships chained across the middle of the river were used as floating works and as a line of blockade. On the side of the assault, the fence works, the cheval-de-frise and the ditch were the first wall in front of the city of Yangliu, and the Jin reached the foot of the rampart by breaking down the cheval-de-frise and filling the ditch; the defenders had scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwing engines and cheval-de-frise of their own, and the Later Tang bore a day-and-night assault by a hundred thousand men with crossbow bolts and timber barriers. What the two weapons share is the business of keeping a formation standing: the Spartans had the bronze socket of the spear and the shields that touched, and the armies of the Five Dynasties had rafts, chained ships and lines of work; at Yangliu nine centuries later, what decided the issue was no longer the length of the spearhead but the control of the floats and of the crossing.
tactics: 此役的戰術可以拆成四段。第一段是破柵強渡：九一七年十二月黃河封凍，李存勖自晉陽抵魏州，二十三日從朝城縣踏冰過河，梁將安彥之率三千兵據楊劉渡口、沿河築柵壘，晉軍毀其鹿角，以蘆葦填壕，攻破楊劉城，俘安彥之，取得黃河南岸的落腳點。第二段是水上的隔河較量：九二三年五月，梁取德勝南城，兩家各拆房舍作木筏，士兵乘筏沿黃河東下，在河中以箭矢互相射擊，一日百次，抵楊劉時雙方傷亡近半；梁軍再以九艘巨艦連接橫置渡口，切斷援軍水路，王彥章退屯城南連營而守，營壘與水道合成兩道封鎖。第三段是築城調敵：六月初二日李存勖至楊劉，見正面守備森嚴，與郭崇韜議定不硬攻，遣郭崇韜率一萬兵連夜趕往博州築新城，李存勖則在楊劉苦戰以牽制梁軍，郭崇韜六天築成新城，王彥章才得到消息，率大軍數萬攻向新城，十五日又以十餘艘巨艦連接橫置河道中央以絕援軍，郭崇韜據新壘抵抗並遣使求援，李存勖率大軍在新城西岸列陣，梁軍見援軍到來，砍斷繩索收船，退鄒家口堅守。第四段是斷纜追擊：七月五日李存勖沿黃河南進，十二日游奕將李紹興在清丘驛南擊敗梁軍游騎，十六日遣李紹榮至梁營擒其哨兵、焚燒相連的戰艦，十七日王彥章得知晉王已到鄒家口，遂撤軍逃向楊村，唐軍追擊，駐軍德勝。全役沒有一次正面會戰，勝負全在築城、設援、斷纜三個動作上：把水障改成陸堡，把水戰改成築城戰，再把水障拆掉。
tacticsEn: The method of this war can be broken into four stages. The first was the storming of the fenced crossing: in the twelfth month of 917 the Yellow River froze over, Li Cunxu came down from Jinyang to Weizhou, and on the twenty-third he crossed the frozen river at Chaocheng County. The Liang general An Yanzhi held the crossing of Yangliu with three thousand men and threw up fenced works along the river; the Jin broke down his cheval-de-frise, filled the ditch with reeds, took the city of Yangliu and took An Yanzhi prisoner, gaining a foothold on the south bank of the river. The second stage was a contest on the water between the two banks: in May 923 the Liang took the south city of Desheng, and each side pulled down houses to make rafts, carried men down the Yellow River on them and exchanged arrows in mid-river a hundred times a day, both sides having lost nearly half their strength by the time they reached Yangliu; the Liang then chained nine great ships across the crossing to cut the water route for relief, and Wang Yanzhang withdrew to the south of the city to camp in a connected line, the works and the waterway together making two locks on the river. The third stage was to build a town in order to draw the enemy off: on the second of June Li Cunxu reached Yangliu, saw how securely the position was held, and agreed with Guo Chongtao not to assault it directly, sending Guo with ten thousand men to ride all night to Bozhou and raise a new town, while Li Cunxu himself fought hard at Yangliu to pin the Liang down. Guo built the new town in six days, and only then did Wang Yanzhang learn of it and move with several tens of thousands to attack; on the fifteenth he chained another ten or more great ships across the middle of the channel to cut off relief, and Guo held the new works and sent for help, and Li Cunxu came up and drew up his army on the west bank of the new town. The Liang, seeing relief arrive, cut their ropes, took up their ships and fell back to Zoujiakou. The fourth stage was to cut the cables and pursue: on the fifth of July Li Cunxu advanced along the river to the south, on the twelfth the Colonel of the Patrol Li Shaoxing defeated the Liang scouts south of the Qingqiu post station, on the sixteenth he sent Li Shaorong into the Liang camp to seize the pickets and burn the chained ships, and on the seventeenth Wang Yanzhang learned that the Prince of Jin had reached Zoujiakou and withdrew towards Yangcun, the Tang pursuing and camping at Desheng. There was no set-piece battle in the whole campaign; the issue was settled by three actions, building a town, bringing up relief, and cutting the cables, that is, turning a barrier of water into a barrier of earth, turning a battle on the river into a battle of town building, and then tearing down the barrier of water itself.
data: 時間上，此役的主體自九二三年五月起，至七月十七日梁軍撤退止，前後約兩月有奇；它的前奏要追到九一七年十二月二十三日晉軍自朝城踏冰渡河、攻破楊劉城俘梁將安彥之，那一次安彥之只領三千兵，楊劉因此成了晉軍在河南的第一座堡壘。兵力上，五月二十六日王彥章與段凝的聯軍號稱十萬，日夜不停攻擊楊劉；六月初二日郭崇韜率大軍一萬連夜赴博州築城，兩家兵力相差懸殊，卻靠新城換取了主動。器械與消耗方面，兩軍在河中互射一日百次，抵楊劉時雙方傷亡近半；梁軍運糧自德勝北城往澶州，損耗近一半；郭崇韜六天築成新城；梁軍先以巨艦九艘、再以十餘艘連接橫置河道，終被晉軍所燒。損失上，梁軍被殺、被溺、傷暑而死達萬人，丟棄物資數以萬計，晉軍保住了楊劉城。地理上，楊劉在今山東東阿縣東北姚寨鎮，隔黃河與德勝南北城相望；博州即今聊城，鄒家口在今聊城東昌府區東南，清丘驛在今河南濮陽東南。至於兩軍在楊劉的總傷亡與城下器械的具體數目，諸史皆略，記錄互有出入。
dataEn: As to time, the main body of the campaign ran from May 923 to the seventeenth of July, when the Liang army withdrew, a matter of a little over two months; its prelude has to be traced back to the twenty-third of December 917, when the Jin crossed the frozen river at Chaocheng, took the city of Yangliu and captured the Liang general An Yanzhi, who on that occasion had only three thousand men under him, and Yangliu thus became the first fortress the Jin held in Henan. On strength, the joint army of Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning on the twenty-sixth of May was put at a hundred thousand men, assaulting Yangliu day and night; on the second of June Guo Chongtao took ten thousand men and rode all night to Bozhou to build a town, and although the two sides were badly mismatched in numbers, that new town bought the initiative. On equipment and expenditure, the two sides exchanged arrows in mid-river a hundred times a day, and by the time they reached Yangliu both had lost nearly half their strength; the Liang moved grain from the north city of Desheng towards Chan Prefecture and lost nearly half of it on the road; Guo raised the new town in six days; the Liang chained up nine great ships and then more than ten across the channel, and these were in the end burned by the Jin. On losses, the Liang lost men killed, drowned and dead of heat until they numbered ten thousand, and abandoned stores counted in tens of thousands, while the Jin kept the city of Yangliu. On geography, Yangliu lies at Yao Zhai in the northeast of Dong'e County in modern Shandong, facing the north and south cities of Desheng across the Yellow River; Bozhou is modern Liaocheng, Zoujiakou lies southeast of Dongchang Prefecture in modern Liaocheng, and the Qingqiu post station lies southeast of modern Puyang in Henan. As for the total casualties of both sides at Yangliu and the exact number of siege engines below the walls, the histories are brief and the records differ from one another.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。第一層是楊劉的地理價值：它卡在黃河下游的渡口上，北面隔河是德勝南北城，南接鄆州、曹州，東可援濮州，西可截汴河；誰控制楊劉，誰就控制河東兵馬進入河南的門戶。九一七年晉軍以踏冰渡河與強攻拿下楊劉，等於把門戶的鑰匙攥在手上，後梁三年之後終於要把它奪回來。第二層是後梁的防線結構：自九一六年魏州之戰後，梁軍退守黃河沿線，楊劉成了這條防線的支點；五月初梁軍先取德勝南城，隔河立柵、造筏、連艦，正是要在楊劉對岸先立起一座可以互相支援的浮堡，把晉軍的援軍水路切斷。第三層是晉軍的戰略需求：李存勖已據河北，糧道與援軍線拉得極長，楊劉是這條線上的第一個節點，若楊劉失守，他根本無法在河南立足；若楊劉在握，他就可以放手南下。第四層是梁廷的孤注一擲：王彥章、段凝傾十萬之眾來打一座渡口小城，是末年梁廷唯一拿得出手的攻勢；一旦失敗，不僅十萬精銳折損，汴京與汴河漕運的屏障也隨之崩塌，梁再沒有第二次機會。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause behind the fighting. The first is the geographical value of Yangliu: it sat on a crossing of the lower Yellow River, with the north and south cities of Desheng across the water to the north, Yun and Cao prefectures to the south, Puyang within reach to the east and the Bian canal cut off to the west. Whoever held Yangliu held the gate by which the armies of Hedong entered Henan. The Jin took Yangliu in 917 with a crossing on the ice and a storm of the walls, which was in effect taking the key of that gate into their own hands, and three years later the Later Liang had to take it back. The second is the structure of the Liang defence: after the battle of Weizhou in 916 the Liang army fell back onto the line of the Yellow River, and Yangliu became the hinge of that line; in early May the Liang took the south city of Desheng and set about palisades, rafts and chained ships on the far bank, precisely in order to raise on the opposite side of the river a floating stronghold that could support the town and cut the water road by which Tang relief came. The third is the strategic need of the Jin army: Li Cunxu already held Hebei, and his supply line and line of reinforcement were stretched to the limit, and Yangliu was the first joint on that line. If Yangliu fell he could not stand in Henan at all; if Yangliu was in his hands he could advance south with a free hand. The fourth is the single throw of the Liang court: for Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning to bring a hundred thousand men against a small town at a river crossing was the only offensive the Liang court had left in its last years, and if it failed then not only would the picked troops be destroyed, but the screen that protected Bianzhou and the grain traffic of the Bian would collapse with them, and the Liang would never get a second such chance.
impact: 此役的直接影響，是楊劉與德勝一線的渡口控制權留在後唐之手，晉軍的南進通道從此打開。七月十六日段凝判斷晉軍將從黃河上游南渡直趨汴梁，而楊劉的失守恰恰證實了他的直覺：不到數月，晉軍便沿河北下，梁的黃河防線從此崩解，汴京與汴河漕運失去屏障。次一層是梁的元氣大傷：十萬精兵折損萬人，被溺與傷暑而死者不計其數，丟棄物資數以萬計，段凝與王彥章的矛盾又令梁廷內部互相猜疑，此後再也組織不起同等規模的野戰。第三層在軍事技術上：這場戰爭把水戰、攻城與野戰揉在一起——拆屋作筏、連艦作壘、以槍弩在河中互射、把渡口當堡壘經營，再以築城調敵、斷其纜索反制，這套打法在五代宋的水軍與河防上被後人沿用。第四層是兵器史上的坐實：卡面那件公元前八世紀的斯巴達長矛，靠槍尾銅套與相接的盾牌在方陣中站住，而九二三年站在楊劉的是木筏、連艦與弩箭；決定一場渡口爭奪的東西，早從矛尖換成了船。
impactEn: The direct effect of this war was that the control of the crossings along the line of Yangliu and Desheng stayed in the hands of the Later Tang, and the channel for the Jin advance to the south was open from that moment. On the sixteenth of July Duan Ning judged that the Tang army had crossed the Yellow River further upstream and was coming down for Bianzhou, and the fall of Yangliu confirmed his instinct exactly: in less than a few months the Jin were marching down the river, the Liang defence of the Yellow River came apart, and Bianzhou and the grain traffic of the Bian lost their screen. The next layer is the damage done to the substance of the Liang: of a hundred thousand picked troops, ten thousand were lost, and men drowned or dead of heat were beyond counting, stores were abandoned to the value of tens of thousands, and the quarrel between Duan Ning and Wang Yanzhang left the Liang court mistrusting itself, so that it could never again raise a field army of the same size. The third layer lies in military technique: this war pressed together fighting on the water, siege and open battle, taking houses apart for rafts, chaining ships into works, shooting at each other in mid-river with spear and crossbow, managing a river crossing as a fortress, and then answering with a new town and by cutting the cables, and that way of doing things was taken up afterwards by the navies and river defences of the Five Dynasties and the Song. The fourth layer is what the weapon on the card settles about the history of arms: the Spartan dory of the eighth century BCE held its place in the phalanx by means of the bronze socket at the butt and the shields that touched, whereas the things that stood at Yangliu in 923 were rafts, chained ships and crossbow bolts. What decided a contest over a river crossing had long since changed from the spearhead to the boat.
result: 結果是楊劉城保全，梁軍攻勢失敗。五月二十六日十萬聯軍的晝夜強攻被鎮使李敬周與宦官焦彥賓所部的守軍擋住，楊劉未失；六月初二日至十五日，郭崇韜在博州築成新城，把梁軍主力吸在新城一線，李存勖親率大軍在新城西岸列陣相援，梁軍砍繩收船，退保鄒家口，攻勢的銳氣就這樣被耗掉。七月十六日李存勖遣李紹榮擒梁營哨兵並燒毀相連的戰艦，封鎖線被切斷；十七日王彥章得知晉王已至鄒家口，撤軍逃向楊村，唐軍追擊，駐軍德勝，梁軍被殺、被溺、傷暑死者達萬人，棄物資數以萬計。段凝在途中責備王彥章不該深入鄆州，梁軍內部的戰略分歧與士氣低落，成為此役最耐人尋味的一幕。對雙方而言，楊劉的勝負已經分明：後梁失去了黃河防線與十萬精銳，後唐保住了渡口、糧道與南下通道。此役之後，晉軍再不必在楊劉停留，可以直趨汴梁；後梁的滅亡，其實是從這座渡口堡壘失守的那一刻開始計的。
resultEn: The result was that the city of Yangliu was saved and the Liang offensive failed. The day-and-night assault of the twenty-sixth of May by the hundred thousand men was held off by the garrison commanded by the town commander Li Jingzhou together with the eunuch Jiao Yanbin, and Yangliu did not fall. Between the second and the fifteenth of June Guo Chongtao raised a new town at Bozhou, drawing the main body of the Liang army onto that line, and Li Cunxu came up in person and drew up his army on the west bank of the new town; the Liang cut their ropes, took up their ships and fell back to hold Zoujiakou, and the edge of the attack was simply worn away. On the sixteenth of July Li Cunxu sent Li Shaorong to seize the Liang pickets and burn the chained ships, and the line of blockade was cut. On the seventeenth Wang Yanzhang learned that the Prince of Jin had reached Zoujiakou, withdrew towards Yangcun, and the Tang pursued and camped at Desheng; the Liang lost men killed, drowned and dead of heat up to ten thousand, and abandoned stores counted in tens of thousands. Duan Ning's rebuke of Wang Yanzhang for driving so deep into Yun Prefecture, and the divergence of strategy and the low morale it exposed in the Liang command, is the most telling moment of the whole campaign. For both sides the result at Yangliu was now clear: the Later Liang had lost its defence of the Yellow River and a hundred thousand picked troops, and the Later Tang had kept the crossing, its grain road and the road south. After this the Jin no longer needed to linger at Yangliu and could go straight for Bianzhou; the destruction of the Later Liang was, in truth, counted from the moment that fortress at the crossing fell.
